name: Implicit State Space via Diophantine Vector Equations
description: Replaces the explicit choice of 3 discrete modes with a requirement to assign 3D non-negative integer vectors that satisfy a system of equations (sum=2, sum of squares=2). These equations have exactly 3 valid integer solutions. The "different mode" constraint is replaced by a vector dot product equality ($V_u \cdot V_v = 1$). This breaks surface pattern matching by hiding the finite, discrete nature of the state space and the inequality constraint behind vector algebra, forcing the model to algebraically deduce that this is still a 3-state coloring problem.
